A food item which restores {{Energy||48-}} {{Energy||84}} when consumed. It can be made in the [[oven]] or purchased from the [[Merchant]]. The quality is dependent on the ingredients used as well as any [[perks]] or [[sermons]] that might be active. Higher quality meals have a larger restorative effect when consumed. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].
